conclusion: Original full-suite snapshot executed in two deterministic partitions; one partition was interrupted in a runtime-data traversal and its remaining files then completed. All original observed failures received fresh passing regression checks. Late modified/new code received explicit focused checks and independent final collection. There was no single final all-green full-suite invocation.
counting_policy: Results overlap and reflect different source snapshots. Never add broad, remainder and focused results into a passing-suite total. Collection is not execution. Expected failures and skips are retained exactly where reported.
privacy: Only test file membership, sanitized failure dispositions, counts, commands and raw-log hashes/paths are saved. No clinical payloads, runtime databases, secrets or raw test logs are included.
